title: Single Number
statement: Given a non-empty array of integers nums where every element appears exactly twice except for one element which appears exactly once, return that single element. Your solution must run in linear time and use only constant extra space.
hints: Think about a bitwise operation that cancels out a value when applied to itself.
XOR is commutative and associative, and x XOR x = 0, x XOR 0 = x.
XOR every element together in a single pass; all paired values cancel out, leaving only the unique element.
